prompt_head:
Role: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant

assessments.note: Meets experience, mentoring, Hono, certification, and degree in progress.
Proficient in Python and Node.js, covering required languages.
Demonstrated full-stack design, build, and shipping of applications.
Experienced with LLM evals, prompt engineering, and AI API integrations.
Skilled in prompt engineering, tool-calling agents, and built LangGraph agents.
Hands‑on with Claude Code, Anthropic API, and AI‑driven pipelines.
Mentoring and sales development roles show strong communication abilities.
Led end‑to‑end projects, supported by project management certification.
Sales and VIP success roles provide solid customer‑facing experience.
Works autonomously with AI tools and adapts to fast‑changing contexts.
Rapid prototyping guided by customer feedback demonstrated in demos and pipelines.
Architected scalable systems, studied distributed architecture in degree program.
Integrated SaaS, CRM, and ETL pipelines across multiple projects.
No explicit evidence of willingness to travel up to 15%.
Bachelor's degree not yet completed (in progress).

output.verdict_line: The candidate meets most core technical and soft skill requirements, with only travel availability and completed degree as gaps.
top_gaps: Willingness to travel up to 15% (no explicit evidence)
Bachelor's degree not yet completed (in progress)
